transforms.name: normalized-context
transforms.effect: The adapter writes used and capacity tokens, and a percentage only when it actually has one.

transforms.name: reduce-percent
transforms.effect: A positive capacity stores context. A missing provider percentage becomes a clamped ratio. Invalidation retracts that claim.

transforms.name: derive-percent
transforms.effect: A finite usedPercent is copied. Otherwise field.context is omitted.
